title: Cao Cao Takes Hanzhong; Zhang Liao Breaks Wu at Xiaoyao Ford Again
summary: Zhang Lu's theocracy in Hanzhong falls. He seals the treasuries before he goes rather than burn them — a courtesy Cao Cao repays by treating him well.

Cao Cao now stands one range of mountains above Liu Bei's brand-new province, and Sima Yi urges him to go straight down into it. He declines, with the remark that a man who has Long should not covet Shu.
history: Historical, and the refusal is one of the great might-have-beens: Yi province was newly conquered and unsteady, and Cao Cao never got so close again.
